about: Hand decisions about MH6 stat blocks and text, applied by scripts/msh/roster.py and scripts/msh/npcs.py after scripts/msh/coverpanels.py parses them. Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.

Facts only - ranks, numbers and labels, never the book's prose - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache. MH6 prints no misprint (survey mh6.md, Stat blocks), so every entry here is a text verdict.

verdict   text              match {row}: an msh_book_text row key. 'read' is a fragment of a few words as the OCR gives it after folding to ASCII, 'printed' the same fragment as the page prints it. It must occur once in the row, or npcs.py stops.
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: Inside cover 4 (PDF 21), the Executioner's MAGICAL AXE., the line at the top of column 2: a grey speck of the scan in the margin before made is read as a double quote. The page prints no quote there and none closes later in the power (seen on a 300 dpi crop of PDF 21).
